name: Thằng Não Tàn và Người Xử Lý
description: Hài hậu tận thế zombie: Chàng trai tự tin mù quáng liên tục gây họa và người bạn xử lý thẳng tay.
story: Trong thế giới hậu tận thế đầy rẫy zombie, anh chàng A luôn tự tin thái quá với những ý tưởng ngớ ngẩn khiến cả nhóm rơi vào cảnh thập tử nhất sinh. Rất may, anh bạn B lạnh lùng luôn có cách giải quyết dứt khoát nhất: xử lý ngay chính A.

characters.name: Character A
characters.description: Young Asian man, 27 years old, messy ruffled brown hair, naive overly confident smirk, wide expressive eyes. Wearing signature post-apocalyptic attire: an oversized distressed olive-green hooded sweatshirt with frayed cuffs over a faded dark henley, patched khaki cargo pants with duct tape on knees, fingerless gloves, scuffed brown hiking boots. Slender build, expressive body language.

Centered front-facing view, looking directly at camera, neutral clean studio background, natural proportions. ONE single person only.

characters.name: Character B
characters.description: Tall muscular Asian man, 33 years old, stoic emotionless weathered face, sharp piercing eyes, short buzz-cut dark hair with a neatly trimmed short stubble beard. Wearing signature attire: a heavy rugged dark brown distressed leather bomber jacket over a fitted charcoal gray crewneck t-shirt, dark tactical utility trousers with belt holsters, heavy black combat boots. Intimidating calm presence.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic comedy thriller, golden hour sunset. Wide shot from behind Survivor Group running down the ruined street. Handheld camera motion. Suddenly Character A steps out into the center of the road, spreading his arms wide with an extremely serious expression, forcing the group to stop. Character B stands behind watching him stoically as a massive Zombie Horde sprints in the distant background.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Survivor Group sprints desperately down the street. Character A steps directly into the center of frame, holding both arms wide shouting: "DỪNG LẠI!". The group screeches to an abrupt halt.
3-6s: Low angle close-up on Character A with a dead-serious face: "Không ai được chạy. Bạn gái tôi vẫn chưa tới." In the background, Zombie Horde roars and rushes closer.
6-8s: Character B steps in calmly without a word, grabs Character A by the collar and hurls him bodily into the approaching zombie swarm as Character A screams: "AAAAAAA!". Character B turns to the group: "Chạy."

Audio: chaotic running footsteps, distant zombie roar, Character A vocal scream fading.
SFX: cloth rustling, heavy body toss impact, wind whistle.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Giữa vòng vây của hàng trăm xác sống, A quyết định dừng cả nhóm lại chỉ vì một lý do không thể ngớ ngẩn hơn.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic tense comedy, dim tungsten bunker lighting. Medium shot inside Underground Bunker. Character A bursts through the steel blast door panting, blocking the door with his hands to stop Survivor Group from sealing it, pointing outward with a proud smile while Character B stares coldly at him.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Hand prepares to slam the heavy bunker door shut. Character A lunges inside panting heavily: "ĐỢI! Bạn tôi vẫn ở ngoài." He points outside.
3-6s: POV shot outside shows Friend of A running with a gigantic Zombie Horde right behind him. Character A grins proudly to Character B: "Thấy chưa? Anh ấy sắp tới rồi."
6-8s: Without blinking, Character B grabs Character A and tosses him out the door. Character A shrieks: "KHÔNG! KHOAN!". Character B pulls Friend of A inside and slams the heavy blast door with a loud CLANG.

Audio: heavy breathing, zombie screech outside, loud metal door slam reverberation.
SFX: metallic lever lock clang, muffled scream.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Tìm được hầm trú ẩn an toàn, nhưng A lại đòi mở cửa đón bạn... kèm theo cả một binh đoàn zombie phía sau.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic deadpan comedy, dusty daylight. Two-shot in Abandoned Supermarket aisle. Character A holding a heavy crate of bottled water with a proud, stingy expression, handing it to Character B while refusing to let anyone drink. Character B calmly unscrews a water bottle and chugs it directly in front of him.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Character A hugs a crate of water tightly, lecturing the thirsty Survivor Group with an authoritative frown: "Phải tiết kiệm. Tin tôi."
3-6s: Character A hands the crate to Character B: "Cất nó đi." Character B silently takes out a bottle, cracks the cap open and drinks deeply. Character A flails his arms: "TÔI BẢO PHẢI TIẾT KIỆM!".
6-8s: Character B calmly sets the bottle down, grabs Character A by the waist and dumps him head-first into a large open green dumpster bin, then hands the bottle to survivors saying: "Uống đi."

Audio: plastic bottle crack, water gulping sounds, hollow plastic dumpster thump.
SFX: dumpster lid rattle, muffled angry protests from inside bin.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Tìm thấy nguồn nước quý giá, A kiên quyết bắt mọi người nhịn khát để tiết kiệm, và cái kết không thể đắng hơn.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic slapstick tension, moody lighting. Close-up on Character A's index finger hovering irresistibly over the bright Emergency Red Button Box mounted on the wall inside Dusty Retail Store, showing an innocent curious smile despite survivors gesturing frantically in the background.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Extreme close-up of Character A's finger hovering over the red button. Character A mutters: "Tôi tự hỏi nó làm gì." Survivor Group gasps: "A, ĐỪNG!". Click! The button is firmly pressed.
3-6s: Instantly deafening emergency sirens wail across the ruined city. Character A blinks innocently: "Ồ. Có lẽ tôi vừa—".
6-8s: Character B steps up in one swift motion, shoves Character A out the front glass door into the street, shuts the door and locks it. Character A runs outside screaming: "TÔI XIN LỖI!". Character B deadpans through glass: "Chạy nhanh hơn."

Audio: deafening high-pitch air raid siren WEE-OOO, frantic footsteps outside.
SFX: metallic button click, glass door latch click.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Tò mò bấm thử chiếc nút đỏ cấm chạm, A đã biến cả thành phố thành bữa tiệc báo động cho lũ zombie.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic comedic absurdity, twilight atmosphere. Medium shot in Overcast Parking Lot: Character A sitting triumphantly in the driver seat of Abandoned SUV revving the wheel, with Character B leaning on the open driver window looking intently at the fuel gauge.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Character A turns the ignition key in Abandoned SUV with supreme confidence: "Tôi lái. Tôi từng chơi game." Engine roars for two seconds then immediately dies with a mechanical choke.
3-6s: Close-up on the fuel gauge needle resting firmly on EMPTY. Character A shrugs awkwardly: "Có vẻ xe bị lỗi."
6-8s: Wide shot: Character B pulls Character A out of the vehicle and forces him to physically pull the front bumper of the SUV with a tow rope while the entire group walks leisurely behind. Character B calmly says: "Ừ. Anh kéo nó."

Audio: engine sputter and die, heavy rope creak, tired panting.
SFX: car door slam, metallic clink of tow hitch.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Tự tin lái xe vì từng chơi game, A nhanh chóng nhận ra đồng hồ xăng đã cạn từ lâu.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic dramatic comedy, moonlit misty night. Low angle shot on Broken Suspension Bridge. Character A gripping a fraying rope hanging over the deep canyon, preparing to swing across with boundless bravado, while Character B stands silently behind him holding combat shears.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Character A grabs a rotten hemp rope at the edge of the broken bridge chasm: "Tin tôi. Thấy chưa? Dễ mà."
3-6s: Character B steps forward with a straight face and cleanly snips the rope with his knife. Character A's rope goes limp. Character A stares in horror: "MÀY VỪA CẮT CÁI GÌ?!".
6-8s: Character A plunges downward into the darkness, landing safely with a loud comical BOING on an inflatable rescue cushion below. Character B turns to the group: "Đi đường khác."

Audio: rope snap twang, falling vocal shriek, rubber cushion impact sound.
SFX: wind howling through bridge cables, soft rebound bounce.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Định biểu diễn đu dây qua vực sâu bằng sợi dây mục, A lập tức nhận được bài học cắt dây từ B.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic suspense comedy, high contrast dark shadows. Tight medium shot inside Safe Room Interior. Everyone sitting motionless holding their breath, sweat beading on their faces. Character A in the center smiling mischievously, tapping the play button on his glowing smartphone.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Tense suffocating silence in the dark room. Character A whispers cheerfully: "Tôi nghĩ chúng ta nên bật nhạc." Everyone violently shakes their head. His thumb hits PLAY.
3-6s: Upbeat blasting pop music erupts loudly from phone speakers. Outside, Zombie Horde roars and pounds violently against the boarded door. Camera shakes.
6-8s: Character B yanks the door open, throws Character A out into the zombie-infested hallway, and slams the door shut. Character A stands surrounded by zombies, nodding to his phone: "...Ít nhất nhạc hay."

Audio: blaring loud dance pop music suddenly muffled through door, zombie snarls.
SFX: rapid wooden door bangs, door latch slam.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Trong căn phòng nín thở trốn zombie, ý tưởng bật nhạc quẩy của A đã giúp anh có ngay một buổi biểu diễn ngoài hành lang.

scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, epic cinematic sunrise comedy, warm golden sunrise lighting. Wide establishing shot on Highrise Rooftop overlooking the ruined city skyline at dawn. Exhausted Survivor Group collapses in relief. Character A steps forward noticing a new Emergency Red Button Box on the rooftop wall with a mischievous grin spreading across his face.
scenes.video_prompt:
0-3s: Glorious golden sunrise over the ruined city. Survivor Group sighs in relief. Character A approaches: "Tôi có một ý tưởng." The entire group shouts in unison: "KHÔNG!".
3-6s: Character A looks at Character B's cold stare and retreats: "...Thôi." Three seconds later, Character A spots a giant red DO NOT PRESS button on the roof antenna wall. A sly smile creeps over his face: "Hmm...".
6-8s: Extreme close-up of Character A's finger clicking the button. Sudden cut to black! An apocalyptic loud air raid horn blasts. Text appears: "NGÀY TẬN THẾ THỨ 13."

Audio: gentle dawn breeze, collective sigh, deafening horn blast after cut to black.
SFX: metallic button click, deep foghorn vibration.
Negative: subtitles, watermark, text overlay.
scenes.narrator_text: Sống sót sau đêm kinh hoàng và đón bình minh, A lại nhìn thấy chiếc nút đỏ cấm bấm thứ hai...
